# Fairholt Baths - visitor counts

Entries are recorded by two turnstiles: the North gate at the main entrance and
the South gate by the pool.

The duty manager reads the Saturday sheet when the leisure committee asks.

turns.prompt: How many people came through on the twelfth?

The North gate, the South turnstile was a manual clicker that day. How many entries did the North gate record on 12 September? Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
